dataset_name: MIDOG 2021 (Medical Image De-Identification & Domain Generalization Challenge)

annotation_protocol_exhaustiveness.scientific_boundary_statement: Each case in MIDOG 2021 represents a standardized 10-HPF tumour ROI (approx 6475 x 4845 pixels, ~2.0 mm²). Within this declared ROI, expert pathologists performed exhaustive screening and consensus annotation. Therefore, unannotated viable tissue regions within this canvas are certified mitosis-negative. However, this is full-ROI spatial generalization, NOT full whole-slide (WSI) depth generalization.
